Load Filtered and Raw 10x Genomics Count Matrices

Source: R/Pre-processing_soupX.R
load_counts.Rd

Batch loads 10x Genomics formatted sparse matrices (matrix, features, and barcodes) for multiple samples. It simultaneously reads both the 'filtered' (cell-containing) and 'raw' (all droplets) outputs from Cell Ranger using Seurat's ReadMtx. Loading both matrices is highly useful for downstream ambient RNA decontamination workflows (such as SoupX) that require the empty droplet background to estimate the ambient RNA profile. Includes a progress bar to track loading status.

Usage

load_counts(sample_names, filtered_dir, raw_dir)

Arguments

sample_names

Character vector. A list of sample identifiers corresponding to the folder prefixes (e.g., as generated by get_sample_names()).

filtered_dir

Character. The parent directory path containing the "*_filtered_feature_bc_matrix" folders.

raw_dir

Character. The parent directory path containing the "*_raw_feature_bc_matrix" folders.

Value

A named list containing two top-level elements:

  • filtered: A named list of the filtered sparse count matrices (dgCMatrix) for each sample.

  • raw: A named list of the raw sparse count matrices (dgCMatrix) for each sample.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# 1. Extract sample names using your helper function
my_samples <- get_sample_names(filtered_dir = "data/filtered_outputs")

# 2. Load both raw and filtered matrices for all samples
counts_list <- load_counts(
  sample_names = my_samples,
  filtered_dir = "data/filtered_outputs",
  raw_dir = "data/raw_outputs"
)

# 3. Access the matrices for the first sample to pass into SoupX
patient1_filt <- counts_list$filtered[["Patient1"]]
patient1_raw  <- counts_list$raw[["Patient1"]]

# Check dimensions
dim(patient1_filt)
dim(patient1_raw)
} # }
